name: color-inline
author: lumine-code
description: Show colors inline and collect them across the project.
backgroundTips: {% if keys['color-inline:show-palette'] %}See every colour a project defines with {{ 'color-inline:show-palette' | keystroke }}.{% else %}Use Color Inline's palette to see every colour a project defines.{% endif %}

{% if keys['color-inline:find-colors'] %}Find every use of a colour across the project with {{ 'color-inline:find-colors' | keystroke }}.{% else %}Color Inline can find every use of a colour across the project.{% endif %}

autocomplete.provider.description: Completes colour names and colour variables while typing.

color-inline.project.description: Exposes the scanned colour project: its palette, its variables and its buffers.

markerType.title: Marker Type
markerType.description: How a colour is drawn in the editor.

enum.description: Background — the text sits on the colour
Underline — a rule beneath the text
Outline — a box around the text
Dot — a round mark before the text
Square dot — a square mark before the text
Gutter — a mark in its own gutter

supportedFiletypes.title: Supported File Types
supportedFiletypes.description: File extensions whose colours are marked. A `*` marks colours everywhere.

filetypesForColorWords.title: File Types for Colour Words
filetypesForColorWords.description: File extensions where a bare name such as `red` or `whitesmoke` counts as a colour. Use a value matching no extension to switch colour words off entirely.

ignoredScopes.title: Ignored Scopes
ignoredScopes.description: Regular expressions matching scopes whose colours are left unmarked. `\.comment` skips every comment.

ignoredBufferNames.title: Ignored Buffer Names
ignoredBufferNames.description: Glob patterns of files that get no colour marks at all.

maxDecorationsInGutter.title: Maximum Marks per Gutter Row
maxDecorationsInGutter.description: How many colours one row of the gutter may show.

delayBeforeScan.title: Delay Before Scan
delayBeforeScan.description: Milliseconds of quiet after typing before the buffer is scanned again. The wait restarts on every keystroke.

sourceNames.title: Source Names
sourceNames.description: Glob patterns of the files scanned for colour variables.

ignoredNames.title: Ignored Names
ignoredNames.description: Glob patterns skipped when scanning the project for variables.

extendedSearchNames.title: Extended Search Names
extendedSearchNames.description: Extra glob patterns searched by Find Colors, on top of the source names.

traverseIntoSymlinkDirectories.title: Traverse Into Symlinked Directories
traverseIntoSymlinkDirectories.description: Follow symlinked directories when scanning the project.

autocompleteScopes.title: Autocomplete Scopes
autocompleteScopes.description: Scopes in which colour names and variables are offered as completions.

extendAutocompleteToVariables.title: Complete Non-Colour Variables
extendAutocompleteToVariables.description: Offer variables that do not hold a colour as completions too.

extendAutocompleteToColorValue.title: Complete Colour Values
extendAutocompleteToColorValue.description: Offer the colour's value alongside its name.

autocompleteSuggestionsFromValue.title: Complete Variables From a Value
autocompleteSuggestionsFromValue.description: Suggest colour variables when a hexadecimal value is typed.

sortPaletteColors.title: Sort Palette Colours
sortPaletteColors.description: The order colours appear in the palette.

enum.description: None — the order they were found in

groupPaletteColors.title: Group Palette Colours
groupPaletteColors.description: How the palette is divided up.

enum.description: By the file each colour is declared in

mergeColorDuplicates.title: Merge Duplicate Colours
mergeColorDuplicates.description: Show one entry for colours whose value is the same.

sassShadeAndTintImplementation.title: Sass Shade and Tint Implementation
sassShadeAndTintImplementation.description: Sass ships no `shade` or `tint`, and the two common libraries define them differently.

notifyReloads.title: Notify on Reload
notifyReloads.description: Report what changed when the Reload command finishes.

dismissableReloadNotifications.title: Reload Notifications Stay Until Dismissed
dismissableReloadNotifications.description: Keep the reload notification on screen until it is closed by hand.
